line: A side hustle idea pops up over kopi today. Write it down; don't pay for the course yet.
Check that subscription you forgot about. Cancelling it is today's best little win.
Bake, doodle or sing in the shower. Just don't post all of it to the group chat.
Your feedback is sharp and right today. Add one nice sentence before you hit send.
Your kind of people are around today. Have lunch together and split the bill fairly.
Someone borrows your idea today. Smile, make yours better, and keep the receipts.
A random video teaches you something useful today. Stop at one, not twelve.
Say yes when someone offers to help today. Even if you could do it yourself.
Your to-do list fights back today. Pick three things and let the rest wait.
Someone in charge notices the details today. Double-check the attachment.
